newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK UNIT WINS FIM 45 MLN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK UNIT WINS FIM 45 MLN ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish construction materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said in a statement on Thursday its Cargotec unit had won orders worth over 45 million markka.
"Partek Cargotec's Government Business Operation, which markets Partek Cargotec's products to defence forces around the world, has secured contracts in excess of FIM 45 million," Partek said.
The Norwegian army ordered load handling systems and container handling units to be delivered by March 1997, it said.
Similar equipments were also ordered by Czech Republic and Canadian military authorities, it said, but gave no details.

"A significant order was also secured for Hiab cranes to Vosper Thornycroft," Partek said, describing the client as a world leading naval ship builder. The cranes would be used on minehunting vessels operated by the Royal Navy of the United Kingdom and to Irish naval vessels, it said.
